# Changelog

## [1.1.0] - 2026-08-01

### Changed
- `generate.js` now emits validated offline chart descriptors and never calls a remote visualization service.
- Added `generate_spreadsheet` to the supported chart type map.
- Map descriptors fall back explicitly when no embedded offline geography is provided.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-07-03

### Added
- Initial standardized package structure.
